name: mastermind
description: Mastermind workflow: planner / critic / executor / auditor with mmcg code-graph as the truth layer. Standards-enforced library of AI agent artifacts.

plugins.name: mastermind-workflow
plugins.description: Planner + critic + executor + auditor + researcher + release subagents. Spec-driven delegation with 7-dimension critic verdict, pre-flight validation, post-flight audit (incl. pre-edit snapshot drift), and parallel incident-response workflow. Engineering canons enforced (no AI slop, YAGNI, non-breaking).

plugins.name: mmcg
plugins.description: Mastermind Codegraph MCP server. Fast multi-language code indexer (Python, TypeScript/TSX, JavaScript/JSX, Rust, C#, Go, Java, PHP, C/C++) with 15 structural query tools (search, callers/callees with edge_kind filter, impact, imports/imported_by, files, symbols_in_file, outline, recent_changes, unreferenced, api_surface, centrality, tasks, dependency_cycles). Local SQLite + tree-sitter, incremental watcher, FTS5 over `.mastermind/tasks/`. Truth layer for the mastermind workflow. C/C++ best-effort (see README Limitations).

plugins.name: mastermind-tools
plugins.description: Standalone skills usable outside the mastermind workflow: pr-review, flaky-finder, doc-stub-sync. Plus the api-shape-explorer prompt template.
